dedupe_keys.name: 3d solar potential analysis results for munich based on citygml semantic city models

description: This dataset holds building-integrated solar potential for the Munich metropolitan area, computed on every roof and wall surface of LoD2 CityGML building models. It was produced by the Chair of Geoinformatics at the Technical University of Munich and the Leibniz Institute of Ecological Urban and Regional Development in a project initiated by the Bavarian surveying agency (LDBV) and the Runder Tisch GIS association. A Java ray-casting tool computes direct and diffuse irradiation and the sky view factor per surface, including shadowing by neighbouring buildings, vegetation and terrain, calibrated with 22-year NASA SSE means. Access: version 1.0.0 was published on Zenodo on 23 March 2026 as two 7z archives of about 21 and 23 GB. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-4.0. Access is free of charge. Caveats: results depend on the LoD2 models and vegetation model used, and the archives are very large. Simulation uses: rooftop and facade photovoltaic planning, building energy supply scenarios and solar layers in city digital twins. Related records: the Bavarian LoD2 building models and 3DCityDB.
